groups.purpose: Fast regression coverage; never a substitute for seven-law release qualification

groups.coverage: Generated reuse and inherited operation-shape regressions; separate scale profile measures fixed CRUD work
groups.remaining: Flat-latency qualification is separate from a passing correctness test

groups.coverage: Commit/checkpoint I/O fault matrix, deliberate process exits and lost-write preservation
groups.remaining: Full create/open/repair-destination failure and publication matrix

groups.coverage: Every profile records source, elapsed time, scope and results; paired benchmark records bytes and maintenance
groups.remaining: Lean timing is diagnostic; phase-boundary sizes are not peak/cap evidence

groups.coverage: CRC/bounds, stale frame, independent raw repair and schema-replica regressions
groups.remaining: Corrupt-WAL salvage and rootless current-membership proof remain open

groups.coverage: Old/new snapshots, uncommitted invisibility, admission and writer ownership
groups.remaining: Cross-process readers, restart beside a survivor and zero-degradation gate

groups.coverage: Typed round trips, opt-in timestamps, reopen and platform isolation; runnable on Pi
groups.remaining: Typed tests use the older collection Store; page-WAL integration, bulk/late indexing/indexed live writes remain pending
